fact: The INS/STP-CNS state-of-statistics report says the government adopted in 2022 the third national statistics development strategy (SNDS III), covering 2022-2026, and that 2024 coordination activities implemented its action plan; the adoption month is not given.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): SNDS 2022-2026.
